title: Patterson-UTI Energy Reports Financial Results for the Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
summary: HOUSTON, TX / ACCESS Newswire / July 29, 2026 / PATTERSON-UTI ENERGY, INC. (NASDAQ:PTEN) today reported financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
